heading: Reported speech

She told that she traveled abroad.
I asked whether he wants to come.
She requested that we come early.
He promised that he would return.

They asked if she was coming.
He asked that we wait.
They announced that it is over.

sentences.en: I asked him if he was happy and he said yes, very.

sentences.en: She told me that they promised her she would get the job.

tips:
## Reported Speech

### Direct vs. Reported Speech
Direct speech uses quotation marks:
- הוא אמר: **"אני עייף."** -- He said: "I am tired."

Reported speech uses **ש** (that):
- הוא אמר **שהוא עייף**. -- He said that he is tired.

### Key Change: Pronouns Shift
| Direct | Reported |
|---|---|
| אני (I) | הוא/היא (he/she) |
| אנחנו (we) | הם/הן (they) |
| שלי (my) | שלו/שלה (his/her) |

Examples:
- "אני **רוצה** ללכת" --> אמר ש**הוא רוצה** ללכת
- "**שלחתי** מכתב" --> אמרה ש**היא שלחה** מכתב

### Reporting Verbs
| Verb | Pattern | Use |
|---|---|---|
| אמר **ש** | said that | Neutral statement |
| סיפר **ש** | told that | Narrative |
| שאל **אם** | asked whether | Questions (note: **אם** not **ש**!) |
| ביקש **ש** | requested that | Requests |
| הודיע **ש** | announced that | Formal info |
| הבטיח **ש** | promised that | Promises |
| טען **ש** | claimed that | Claims |

### Questions in Reported Speech
Use **אם** (if/whether), not **ש**:
- "**אתה** בא?" --> שאל **אם הוא** בא.
- "Did you come?" --> He asked whether he was coming.

### Requests in Reported Speech
Use **ש** + future tense:
- "**תבוא** מוקדם" --> ביקש **שיבוא** מוקדם.
- "Come early" --> He asked that he come early.
